title: Universe transfer for normalized endpoint scalar identity
statement: For a ring stage identity coefficient change, transfer the multiplication-normalized ScalarIdentity certificate from an equal-universe algebraically closed coefficient field Ψ of universe max u v to Ω of universe v, for the explicitly case-defined scalarAtClosure record.

proof.text: Case split on finite and integral ring stages. The underlying coefficient categories, inclusion functors, and ambient tensor identity are definitionally independent of the coefficient closure; only derived-category universe parameters differ.
Transport the identity isomorphism and its normalization equality across the maximum-universe to original-universe categorical presentations, preserving the literal multiplication tensor unitor.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarIdentityAtClosure
    (Ψ : Type (max u v)) [Field Ψ] [Algebra (Padic l) Ψ] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ψ]
    (W : Scheme.{max u v}) {s : RingStage.{max u v} l}
    {a : PurCompactSupport.Change (s.coefficients l) (s.coefficients l)}
    (h : ∀ T : Scheme.{max u v}, a.map T = 𝟙 _)
    (S : Scalar.{max u v, max u v} l Ψ a W)
    (I : ScalarIdentity.{max u v, max u v} l Ψ h W S) :
    Nonempty (ScalarIdentity.{u, v} l Ω h W (scalarAtClosure.{u, v} l Ω Ψ W S))
